item.title: Today in Black History: February 5th
item.description: 1884 – Willis Johnson Patented the Mechanical Egg Beater Willis Johnson of Cincinnati patented an improved mechanical egg beater on February 5, 1884, transforming how people mixed ingredients. Before his invention, blending foods by hand was slow and tiring. Johnson’s double-acting device, featuring spring-like whisk wires, made beating batter and eggs faster and more efficient. […]
